Review the full current SHACL against the supplied regulation, declared schema/representation and approved research scope. Return one complete JSON object matching expected_response_schema; its description is the authoritative response contract. Review all source obligations, query branches, activation, changes/removals and prior issues. Successful execution is not proof of correctness.

Regulation establishes the obligation. Declared schema/representation establishes RDF identifiers, paths, units and datatypes. Approved scope establishes an external research population assumption, not real-vessel certification. A regulation need not literally contain an RDF IRI. A vocabulary label/mapping does not establish a regulatory formula or compliance answer. Genuine missing or contradictory mappings remain context questions; do not weaken code to bypass them.

Report code issues with description, E evidence references, code location and an actionable suggested correction. Report context questions with exactly what is missing, why it matters and source/schema retrieval kind; no invented code defect. Cite E IDs, optionally a character span. Software extracts exact evidence text and code, attaches candidate hashes and maintains stable issue/reconciliation state. Do not reproduce those fields. If you assert an optional quote, preserve it exactly; supplied references do not prove their interpretation.

For proposed representation changes only, operands may explicitly pair a property, full IRI path and PROPERTY or NUMERIC_OPERAND role, with unit/datatype if proposed. Do not concatenate unrelated owner branches, rename units as conversion, invent undeclared paths or silently override a contradiction. Code evidence locations are current-candidate lines by default. Missing constraints use a real insertion anchor. Reference previous code only through supplied change IDs; software retains exact previous/current bytes.

Assess every supplied functional change/removal once, including reachable replacements. Supported removal needs the appropriate source/schema/scope evidence; checker silence is not support. Material context questions prevent repair/acceptance. APPROVE asserts no current or prior issue remains, all changes are supported and all supplied gaps are explicitly nonmaterial. Artifact delivery is separate from approval.

Failed responses are not prior issues or repair permission. The same candidate/evidence/prior state is retained for the existing single shared response correction. Return the complete response; never rewrite candidate code in review. Do not request evaluation fixtures, labels, counterparts, expected verdicts or historical solutions.
